blocks.html: Operations is everything that keeps IHOT running off the field: sponsorships and budget, outreach, media and social, awards and event logistics. If the robot is the engine, operations is the fuel.

Use the official logo files as they are. Do not recolor, stretch or redraw them. Our colors:

  • IHOT blue #3E75B7
  • Navy #07121F and #142943
  • Light blue #7EA9DD and #D6E4F5

Headings use Space Grotesk and body text uses Inter.

1. Research local companies connected to engineering, manufacturing or our families.
  2. Reach out with a short, personal message and our sponsor packet.
  3. Follow up, and thank every sponsor publicly on social media and at events.
  4. Send sponsors a season recap with photos of what they helped build.
